vessels.description: Large clear heatproof glass mixing bowl
8 by 8 inch square silver metal pan with parchment overhang
Small brushed stainless steel saucepan with black handle
Medium matte white ceramic bowl for dry ingredients

shots.title: Grease the pan
shots.action: The hand lightly sprays the inside of the stationary metal pan.
shots.startState: Empty silver 8 by 8 inch pan on the oak counter; cooking spray held above it.
shots.endState: Inner pan surfaces lightly greased.
shots.reviewNote: Set oven rack to middle and preheat to 350°F (175°C) off camera.

shots.title: Line the pan
shots.action: The hand presses parchment gently into the greased pan.
shots.startState: Greased pan; parchment sheet held above its interior.
shots.endState: Pan lined with parchment leaving a 1 inch overhang on two opposite sides.

shots.title: Brown the butter
shots.action: The blue spatula slowly stirs the browned butter.
shots.startState: Butter already melted in the steel saucepan; amber milk solids visible.
shots.endState: Amber browned butter remains in the saucepan.
shots.reviewNote: Cook butter over medium heat, stirring frequently, about 7 minutes. Cut past heating time; do not animate butter instantly changing color.

shots.title: Transfer browned butter
shots.action: The hand tips the saucepan once, pouring browned butter into the stationary glass bowl.
shots.startState: Saucepan with browned butter held above the empty large heatproof glass bowl.
shots.endState: All browned butter transferred to the heatproof bowl.
shots.reviewNote: Transfer immediately after browning; retain the saucepan without wiping it out.

shots.title: Add measured spices
shots.action: The hand tips the measured spices into the stationary bowl.
shots.startState: Browned butter in the glass bowl; one small container holds the measured spices.
shots.endState: Measured cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and allspice rest in the butter.

shots.title: Whisk the spices
shots.action: The hand moves the whisk through the spiced butter in three slow circles.
shots.startState: All measured spices already in butter; whisk touching the mixture.
shots.endState: Spices dispersed in the browned butter.

shots.title: Reduce pumpkin
shots.action: The blue spatula slowly stirs the thick reduced pumpkin.
shots.startState: Pumpkin already in the same steel saucepan, with browned bits incorporated; puree visibly drier.
shots.endState: Reduced pumpkin remains visibly dry and thick.
shots.reviewNote: Add puree to retained pan and stir in browned bits. Cook medium heat until sizzling and large bubbles form, 2–3 minutes, then cook 5–6 minutes more until reduced to 1/3 cup plus 1 tablespoon (96 g). Cut past elapsed cooking time.
ingredientAmounts: 2/3 cup (144 g) canned pumpkin purée from 1 (15-ounce; 425 g) can (see notes)

shots.title: Transfer pumpkin
shots.action: The hand scrapes reduced pumpkin from the saucepan into the stationary glass bowl.
shots.startState: Reduced pumpkin in saucepan held above the glass bowl containing spiced browned butter.
shots.endState: Reduced pumpkin sits in the spiced butter.
ingredientAmounts: 2/3 cup (144 g) canned pumpkin purée from 1 (15-ounce; 425 g) can (see notes)

shots.title: Whisk pumpkin and butter
shots.action: The whisk makes three slow circles through the pumpkin mixture.
shots.startState: Reduced pumpkin and spiced butter already together; whisk touching mixture.
shots.endState: Pumpkin and butter combined into one smooth mixture.
shots.reviewNote: Refrigerate uncovered about 20 minutes until cooled to room temperature. The next shot starts after cooling; do not animate cooling.
ingredientAmounts: 2/3 cup (144 g) canned pumpkin purée from 1 (15-ounce; 425 g) can (see notes)

shots.title: Whisk dry ingredients
shots.action: The whisk moves slowly through the dry ingredients.
shots.startState: Measured flour, salt and baking soda already in medium white ceramic bowl; whisk touching flour.
shots.endState: Dry ingredients evenly combined in the white bowl.
ingredientAmounts: 1 teaspoon Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume

shots.title: Add sugars
shots.action: The hand tips the measured sugars into the stationary glass bowl.
shots.startState: Cooled pumpkin mixture in the glass bowl; one measured sugar container held above it.
shots.endState: Both source quantities of sugar rest in the pumpkin mixture.
shots.reviewNote: Review the source instruction and retain its cooking and waiting times.
ingredientAmounts: 3/4 cup packed dark brown sugar (5 3/4 ounces; 163 g)

shots.title: Add vanilla
shots.action: The hand pours the measured vanilla into the stationary bowl.
shots.startState: Sugars already added; a small measured vanilla cup is poised above the glass bowl.
shots.endState: The measured vanilla has joined the sugars and pumpkin mixture.
shots.reviewNote: Review the source instruction and retain its cooking and waiting times.

shots.title: Whisk
shots.action: The hand moves the whisk in three slow circles through the mixture.
shots.startState: The sugars and vanilla already sit in the pumpkin mixture; whisk touching mixture.
shots.endState: The sugars, vanilla and pumpkin mixture are evenly combined.
shots.reviewNote: Review the source instruction and retain its cooking and waiting times.
ingredientAmounts: 2/3 cup (144 g) canned pumpkin purée from 1 (15-ounce; 425 g) can (see notes)
3/4 cup packed dark brown sugar (5 3/4 ounces; 163 g)

shots.title: Fold flour
shots.action: The blue spatula folds the flour mixture through the wet mixture.
shots.startState: Flour mixture already added on top of wet mixture; spatula resting against the side.
shots.endState: Only a few dry streaks of flour remain in the thick dough.
shots.reviewNote: Review the source instruction and retain its cooking and waiting times.
ingredientAmounts: 1 teaspoon Diamond Crystal kosher salt; for table salt, use half as much by volume

shots.title: Fold chips
shots.action: The blue spatula folds the chocolate chips through the thick dough.
shots.startState: One cup chocolate chips rests on thick dough; blue spatula touching dough.
shots.endState: Chocolate chips evenly distributed and no dry flour remains.
shots.reviewNote: Review the source instruction and retain its cooking and waiting times.
ingredientAmounts: 1 cup chocolate chips resting on the dough, to fold in

shots.title: Scrape dough into pan
shots.action: The blue spatula scrapes dough from glass bowl into the stationary pan.
shots.startState: Thick chocolate-chip dough in glass bowl tilted above prepared parchment-lined pan.
shots.endState: Dough rests in prepared pan.
ingredientAmounts: 1 cup chocolate chips already in the dough

shots.title: Level the dough
shots.action: The blue spatula slowly levels the dough surface.
shots.startState: Dough already in prepared pan, blue spatula touching surface.
shots.endState: Dough spread in an even layer.
ingredientAmounts: 1 cup chocolate chips already in the dough

shots.title: Top with chips
shots.action: The hand gently scatters the measured chips over the level dough.
shots.startState: Level dough in pan; measured remaining 1/4 cup chips held above it.
shots.endState: Remaining chips distributed evenly and lightly settled into dough.
shots.reviewNote: Gently press chips into dough after sprinkling.
ingredientAmounts: Remaining 1/4 cup chocolate chips to add on top

shots.title: Check the baked center
shots.action: The hand slowly withdraws the skewer from the center of the baked bars.
shots.startState: Bars already baked in same pan; dry top and just-set soft center; wooden skewer touching center.
shots.endState: Skewer withdrawn clean or streaked only with melted chocolate.
shots.reviewNote: Bake 25–30 minutes at 350°F (175°C) before this shot. Use an editorial cut to the baked state rather than a time-lapse food transformation.
ingredientAmounts: 1 cup chocolate chips already in the dough

shots.title: Cool on the rack
shots.action: The hands gently lower the pan onto the wire rack.
shots.startState: Pan of baked bars held just above rectangular wire rack.
shots.endState: Pan rests on cooling rack.
shots.reviewNote: Let bars cool completely in pan, 1–2 hours before the next shot.

shots.title: Lift cooled bars
shots.action: The hands slowly lift the cooled bars using the parchment overhang.
shots.startState: Completely cooled bars in pan; hands hold parchment overhang on two opposite sides.
shots.endState: Cooled slab lifted clear of the pan on its parchment.

shots.title: Cut and serve
shots.action: The hand presses the knife straight down through one marked portion line.
shots.startState: Cooled slab on parchment on oak counter, marked into 12 portions; knife at one dividing line.
shots.endState: Knife completes one straight cut, showing the 12 planned portions.
shots.reviewNote: Cut all 12 portions and serve; show one representative cut rather than multiple rapid actions.
